references.text: Jesus repeats the motif that faith depends on seeing God's glory, and that his absence (earlier) was part of the plan to bring about this faith.
Jesus expresses joy that the disciples will see him again and that their faith will be made complete, paralleling the joy over them believing because of his absence in John 11.
Jesus blesses those who believe without having seen him physically, a theme central to John 11:15 where he says he was glad because he was not there, so that they might believe.
